product.audience: Design-led jewelry clients choosing material, stone character and how a piece behaves in different light
product.decision: Configure a ring by metal, center stone and light environment
product.conversion: Issue a fictional atelier study card with the chosen facet and size

signature.moment: A movable beam crosses an extreme gemstone portrait, breaking into a live reflection bloom whose color, direction and shadow change with metal, stone and light angle

systems.hero: Macro ring portrait divided by a diagonal physical light blade and magnified facet captions
systems.navigation: Jeweler bench scale with live karat and angle readout
systems.contentDensity: Sensory macro opening, evidence of craft, then a precise visual configurator
systems.geometry: Loupe circles, facet polygons, prong diagrams, light rays and bench rulers
systems.motion: Scroll sweeps a narrow light blade across macro surfaces; controls rotate the reflected beam and change bloom
systems.coreInteraction: Metal, stone and light environment update the ring rendering, reflection spectrum, angle, brilliance, shadow and study card

structuralDifferences: Hero becomes one magnified circular stone window over the hand portrait
Light table stacks a thumb-controlled loupe above three material rails
Craft evidence becomes a vertical bench ruler
Outcome is a compact gem paper folded inline

artDirection.typography: Refined editorial serif with engraved micro numerals
artDirection.material: Brushed gold, cool platinum, rose metal, diamond, sapphire, garnet, frosted glass and hard prism light
artDirection.imageLogic: Original macro and human craft photography carries authenticity; CSS facets, rays and bloom visualize the configuration
artDirection.microcopy: Facet, prong, table, pavilion, brilliance, shadow, karat and loupe
artDirection.dataHonesty: Brilliance and value figures are illustrative; no appraisal, order or material claim is made

adjacentTemplates.why: The existing atelier tells a craft story; LUCENT is an optical light-testing instrument centered on reflection behavior.
PRISM changes a view through lenses; LUCENT directs light onto a physical facet and metal.
Watch allocation focuses mechanics and ownership; this explores beam angle, stone and reflection.
SILLAGE blends atmospheric layers; LUCENT deals in hard surfaces, loupe magnification and reflected rays.
MERIDIAN uses linear travel and packing cells; LUCENT uses radial facets and light vectors.
